children: Audience Engagement Remains Elevated Through the First Three Quarters of 2026 as Kartoon Channel! Enters Its Historically Strongest Seasonal Viewing Period with Expanded Halloween and Holiday Programming
BEVERLY HILLS, CA / ACCESS Newswire / October 28, 2026 /
Kartoon Studios
a global entertainment company creating, producing, distributing and licensing children's and family content
today announced strong growth across its streaming platforms,
Kartoon Channel!
and
Ameba

, with total hours watched on its subscription video-on-demand (SVOD) platforms more than doubling year-over-year through the first three quarters of 2026. The performance builds on an acceleration in viewing that began in the fourth quarter of 2025 and has continued through the first three quarters of 2026, demonstrating continued audience engagement rather than a short-term viewing spike.

The strength of the platforms is particularly notable as Kartoon Channel! and Ameba enter Q4, historically one of the most active periods for children's and family entertainment. Last year's Halloween programming generated an increase in viewing, and Kartoon Channel! enters the 2026 Halloween and holiday season from a substantially higher level of viewing. With an expanded slate of seasonal programming planned across the platform, the Company expects the fourth quarter to provide additional opportunities to build viewing momentum and deepen engagement with its growing number of subscribers.

"The continued growth of Kartoon Channel! and Ameba is an important validation of the investments we have made in building an owned distribution platform with the ability to reach and retain a family audience," said
Andy Heyward, Chairman & CEO of Kartoon Studios

. "What is particularly encouraging is that this is not a one-quarter event. We saw the growth begin in Q4 2025, and the elevated levels of engagement have continued throughout 2026. As we enter the key Halloween and holiday viewing period, we believe our platforms are well positioned to serve as an important component of Kartoon Studios' broader growth and monetization strategy."
Todd Steinman, President of Toon Media Networks at Kartoon Studios

added, "We are seeing deepening subscriber engagement across our SVOD business, with watch hours more than doubling year-over-year. The consistency of our growth throughout the year is especially meaningful because it reflects sustained demand for our content across our subscriber base. Our expanded Halloween and holiday programming is expected to give us an opportunity to build on that foundation during the strongest seasonal windows of the year, while continuing to use audience data to inform our programming and acquisition strategy."

The growth in SVOD engagement represents another step in Kartoon Studios' strategy to scale its owned distribution ecosystem across SVOD, AVOD, FAST and other digital platforms. Through Toon Media Networks, the Company continues to expand the reach and monetization potential of its content portfolio while using audience consumption data to guide programming, content acquisition and platform strategy.

Kartoon Channel! and Ameba enter the fourth quarter with an expanded lineup of recognizable family entertainment properties and strategic content partners. The additions are expected to further strengthen the platform's seasonal programming strategy and provide audiences with a broader range of content during the Halloween and holiday viewing period.
About Kartoon Studios
Kartoon Studios

is a global, vertically integrated children's and family entertainment company turning owned and controlled intellectual property into enduring, multi-platform franchises. The Company develops, produces, distributes, licenses and monetizes content across the full value chain, creating multiple revenue opportunities and long-term brand value.

Kartoon Studios' growth portfolio includes Hundred Acre Wood and the Stan Lee Universe, alongside established brands and an extensive programming library. The Company operates Mainframe Studios and Toon Media Networks, as well as Beacon Media Group, a full-service marketing, communications, and media agency subsidiary of Kartoon Studios focused on children and family. Together, these assets provide production capabilities, direct audience access and distribution across linear television, AVOD, SVOD, FAST channels and streaming platforms in more than 60 territories. Kartoon Studios is focused on converting its intellectual property, infrastructure and global reach into scalable franchise growth and long-term shareholder value.
